name: 21st.dev
what: Registry of 12,000+ community React + Tailwind components and templates, with live previews and copy-paste code.
best_for: Letting the AI search and install real components
ai_access: MCP + CLI + API key (generate at 21st.dev/mcp). Docs for agents: 21st.dev/llms.txt

name: Savee
what: Curated design reference library (6M+ images) with boards; saves can be browsed by an AI.
best_for: Building a mood board the AI designs from
ai_access: MCP connector (savee.com/mcp). Needs a paid Savee plan. Read access by default; write access is optional.

name: Refero
what: Library of real website and app screens and flows, searchable by AI.
best_for: Web design references with an AI connection
ai_access: MCP (api.refero.design/mcp). Per research: Pro, Team or Lifetime plans. Plan terms not yet checked.

name: Are.na
what: Open collecting tool for building mood boards and research channels.
best_for: Collecting Anouk's references where the AI can read them
ai_access: MCP (mcp.are.na/mcp). Per research: apparently free. Not yet tested.

name: ScreensDesign
what: App screen and flow library with recordings of real products.
best_for: Seeing how real app flows animate
ai_access: MCP on the Pro plan, per research. Plan terms not yet checked.

name: Figma
what: Design tool whose MCP lets an AI read design files and turn them into code.
best_for: Going from an approved design to code
